夏萱不是自杀的，而是谋杀。

凶手是周毅，那个官二代，时笙弄的那些照片和视屏，都是从这个人电脑里弄出来的。

当年那件事后，周毅就带着那些东西出了国，一直在国外，可他骨子里就是那样的人，根本止不住脑中那些邪恶黑暗的想法，一开始他只是看看那些照片视频，以此来疏解欲望。

随着时间，那些东西已经没办法带给他多少快感，他忍不住下手。

第一次得手后，他尝到了甜头，再次沉沦进那无尽深渊。

这么多年，从来没有被人发现过，还让他找到了几个志同道合的朋友。

可是就在不久前，他莫名其妙的收到一些漫骂信息，从那些只言片语他看到了夏萱的名字，网上一搜才知道出大事了。

他都不知道自己为什么要去杀夏萱。

当时就像是有一个声音，在他脑中不断的盘旋，让他去杀了夏萱。

周毅被抓，当年的事也被他交代了出来，他手上甚至是有当时几人分尸时的视屏，血腥残忍。

他说当时所有的人都吸了毒，他们是在那旧教学楼发现那对情侣的，仗着人多，准备对他们施虐，可是那两个人反抗得厉害，女生不知被谁推了一下，脑袋撞到了地上的尖锐物体上，当场死亡。

男生见此反抗得更厉害，一群人当时嗨得很疯，根本没意识到有人死了，反而对着男生施虐，导致男生活活被折磨死。

分尸的提议周毅也想不起来是谁提的。

有视屏，证据充足，夏萱锒铛入狱，当时参与的人，全被警方缉拿归案。

这件事闹得这么大，那些家里的势力在大，也不敢明目张胆的做手脚，只得请律师，一切按程序走。

按照各自家里的人指示，所以人都表示自己吸了毒，当时神志不清，属于过失杀人。

可是警方从视屏中看，他们的思维正常，神智清晰，分尸离开后，还知道抹除证据，警方认为是故意杀人罪。

警方还找到了当时被施虐的几个人，劝说他们出庭作证，也许是怕报复，只有一个人站了出来。

即便如此，那几个人还是被处以故意杀人罪和故意伤害罪，因其情节恶劣，判刑也比较重。

但是在宣判不久后，夏萱和周毅两人就被送到了精神病院。

时笙看完报道，无声的笑了笑，以为进了精神病院就可以逃脱了吗？

那个地方，进去了没病也得弄出病来，夏萱能撑多久呢？

夏萱这么快就玩完，还得多亏周毅，如果不是他，夏萱不在医院住那么久的院，肯定还会蹦哒一段时间。

夏萱这条线算是完成了，席墨就交给陆清韵好了。

Xia Xuan did not commit suicide, but committed murder.

The murderer was Zhou Yi, that second-generation official. The photos and videos Shi Sheng created were all obtained from this person's computer.

After that incident, Zhou Yi took those things out of the country and stayed abroad all the time. But he was that kind of person at heart and couldn't stop the evil and dark thoughts in his mind. At first, he just looked at those photos and videos to relieve his desire.

As time passed, those things could no longer bring him much pleasure, so he couldn't help but take action.

After succeeding for the first time, he tasted the sweetness and sank into the endless abyss again.

In all these years, he has never been discovered by anyone, and he has found several like-minded friends.

But not long ago, he received some abusive messages inexplicably. From those few words, he saw Xia Xuan's name, and after searching online, he realized that something serious had happened.

He didn't even know why he wanted to kill Xia Xuan.

At that time, it was as if there was a voice constantly swirling in his mind, asking him to kill Xia Xuan.

Zhou Yi was arrested and he confessed what happened back then. He even had a video of several people dismembering their bodies, which was bloody and cruel.

He said that everyone was on drugs at the time, and they found the couple in the old teaching building. Taking advantage of the crowd, they prepared to torture them, but the two people resisted fiercely. The girl was pushed by someone unknown, and her head hit a sharp object on the ground. She died on the spot.

Seeing this, the boys resisted even more fiercely. A group of people were so excited that they did not realize that someone was dead. Instead, they tortured the boys, causing the boys to be tortured to death.

Zhou Yi couldn't remember who proposed the idea of ​​dismembering the body.

There was video and sufficient evidence, and Xia Xuan was imprisoned. All those involved at that time were arrested and brought to justice by the police.

This matter was such a big deal, and the powerful families didn't dare to do anything blatantly, so they had to hire a lawyer and follow the procedures.

According to the instructions of their respective families, everyone said that they had taken drugs and were delirious at the time, which constituted manslaughter.

However, the police saw from the video that they were thinking normally and were conscious. After dismembering the bodies and leaving, they also knew to erase the evidence. The police believed that it was intentional homicide.

The police also found several people who were abused at the time and persuaded them to testify in court. Perhaps out of fear of retaliation, only one person came forward.

Even so, those people were still charged with intentional homicide and intentional injury. Because of the seriousness of the circumstances, the sentences were relatively heavy.

But not long after the verdict was announced, Xia Xuan and Zhou Yi were sent to a mental hospital.

After reading the report, Shi Sheng smiled silently. Did he think he could escape by entering a mental hospital?

In that place, you will get sick even if you don't get sick. How long can Xia Xuan last?

Xia Xuan finished playing so quickly, thanks to Zhou Yi. If it weren't for him, Xia Xuan would have been playing around for a while if she hadn't stayed in the hospital for so long.

Xia Xuan's line is now complete, and Xi Mo will be handed over to Lu Qingyun.
